Results.ReviewText:
I decided to invest in a Weber grill based on recommendations from friends.  I have gone through cheaper products very quickly so expecting this one to last a lot longer.
This grill was easy to assemble and easy to use.  I like the holding system that doubles as a gauge for measuring the level of propane left in the tank.  A big plus is the even heating of the entire cooking surface and limited flare ups.
The only thing that is preventing me from giving 5 stars is the inability to set a low temperature setting; even with the dials turned all the way down, temp stays above 300 degrees.
Results.Title: So far, so good.

45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.


 This product requires assembly.
